design_detail: up to 5% on multimillionaires and billionaires
quote_original: Chỉ cần mức thuế thu tới 5% đối với triệu phú và tỷ phú thế giới có thể mang lại 1,7 nghìn tỷ USD mỗi năm, đủ để giúp 2 tỷ người thoát nghèo và tài trợ cho kế hoạch toàn cầu để chấm dứt nạn đói.
quote_en: A tax of up to 5% on the world’s multi-millionaires and billionaires could raise .7 trillion a year, enough to lift 2 billion people out of poverty, and fund a global plan to end hunger.
source_title: [Report] SURVIVAL OF THE RICHEST: How we must tax the super-rich now to fight inequality | Oxfam in Vietnam
grading_note: Official publication by Oxfam in Vietnam advocating an annual wealth tax of up to 5% on multimillionaires and billionaires.

design_detail: tax the richest to end extreme wealth
quote_original: Oxfam urges governments to tax the richest to reduce inequality, end extreme wealth, and dismantle the new aristocracy.
source_title: Billionaire wealth surges by  trillion in 2024, three times faster than the year before, while the number of people living in poverty has barely changed since 1990
grading_note: Press release published by Oxfam in Vietnam urging governments to tax the richest to end extreme wealth.

design_detail: taxing the wealth of millionaires and billionaires to raise $1.8 trillion annually
quote_original: Oxfam tính toán rằng đánh thuế tài sản vào các triệu phú và tỉ phú có thể mang lại 1,8 nghìn tỉ USD mỗi năm.
quote_en: Oxfam calculates that taxing the wealth of millionaires and billionaires could generate $1.8 trillion a year.
source_title: Thập kỷ phân hóa giàu nghèo | Oxfam tại Vietnam
grading_note: Official 2024 Davos Inequality Inc. release on Oxfam in Vietnam website advocating annual wealth tax on millionaires and billionaires with explicit revenue projection.

design_detail: taxing the wealth of richest 1% including net wealth tax
quote_original: Đánh thuế tài sản của 1% những người giàu nhất với mức thuế suất đủ cao để giảm đáng kể số lượng và tài sản của những người giàu nhất, và tái phân bổ những nguồn lực này. Điều này bao gồm thực hiện thuế thừa kế, tài sản và đất đai, cũng như thuế tài sản ròng.
quote_en: Tax the wealth of the richest 1% at rates high enough to significantly reduce the numbers and wealth of the richest people, and redistribute these resources. This includes implementing inheritance, property and land taxes, as well as net wealth taxes.
source_title: NGHỊCH LÝ VỀ SỰ TỒN TẠI CỦA NHÓM SIÊU GIÀU: Cần đánh thuế nhóm siêu giàu như thế nào để giải quyết bất bình đẳng | Oxfam in Vietnam
grading_note: Official Vietnamese press release by Oxfam in Vietnam explicitly demanding net wealth taxes (thuế tài sản ròng) on the richest 1%.

design_detail: higher taxes on wealth and high incomes
quote_original: Governments should increase taxes on both wealth and high incomes to ensure a more level playing field
source_title: Just 8 men own same wealth as half the world | Oxfam in Vietnam
grading_note: Oxfam in Vietnam press release for the 2017 Davos report calls on governments to raise taxes on wealth; no rate or base, so B.

design_detail: global tax of 1.5% on billionaires' wealth
quote_original: Oxfam estimates a global tax of 1.5 percent on billionaires’ wealth could pay for every child to go to school.
source_title: Richest 1 percent bagged 82 percent of wealth created last year - poorest half of humanity got nothing, says Oxfam | Oxfam in Vietnam
grading_note: Press release published on Oxfam in Vietnam's site names a rate (1.5%) and a base (billionaires' wealth) as part of Oxfam's call to governments.

design_detail: 0.5% extra tax on the wealth of the richest 1%
quote_original: Getting the richest one percent to pay just 0.5 percent extra tax on their wealth could raise more money than it would cost to educate the 262 million children out of school
source_title: Oxfam’s report to Davos: Public Good or Private Wealth? | Oxfam in Vietnam
grading_note: Press release for the Davos 2019 report, with a Vietnamese translation on the same page, gives a specific rate and base (0.5% extra on the wealth of the richest 1%).

quote_original: introducing progressive taxation, including taxing wealth and legislating in favour of carers, are possible and crucial first steps
source_title: [Report] Time To Care | Oxfam in Vietnam
grading_note: Report page on Oxfam in Vietnam's site calls for taxing wealth without rate or base, so B.

design_detail: wealth tax policy for Indonesia, the Philippines and Vietnam; Vietnam revenue estimated at US$3.09bn, 2% top rate
quote_original: The government and parliament of Southeast East Asian countries should draw up a policy on wealth tax and increase the tax rate on passive income sources
source_title: Policy Brief 42: Wealth Tax to Fight Asymmetrical Distribution of Tax Burden
grading_note: Policy brief recommends a wealth tax policy and estimates its yield for Vietnam; its recommendations name the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Rate and revenue are given, so A.

design_detail: targeted wealth taxation of high-net-worth individuals; sharply taxing wealth
quote_original: Targeted wealth taxation must correct systemic tax policy failures
source_title: TAFJA open letter to Asian delegates at the UN Tax Convention negotiations
grading_note: ActionAid Vietnam is named by the letter's authors as an endorser (roster, so B); the letter calls for taxing wealth and HNWIs without a rate or base.
